## Definition of done

- [ ] ADR exists and is linked
- [ ] Change is in `solution/` under source control (if it touches Dataverse)

- [ ] **Upgrade impact declared** in the ADR
- [ ] **Licensing flag set** ([docs/LICENSING.md](../docs/LICENSING.md))
- [ ] Tier stated: configuration / low-code / pro-code — and why not a lower tier
- [ ] Pipeline green — evidence linked below

- [ ] For data-plane changes: feature lineage + owner named ([data-engineer-scientist](../.github/agents/data-engineer-scientist.agent.md))
